items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: He used to teach me but I never played any by bass.

ctx.x: Well tell us about when you first took up music, about how old were you? You took up the bass you just told us you took the... No, no, I took up the bass. I used to practice on the bass when I was a little fella.

About 14, 15 years old. Used your father's bass then? Used my father's bass. Did you have any lessons? Did he help you with it and teach you? He used to teach me but I never played any by bass. Yeah. I was just practicing around the house. Yeah.
You didn't take any other instrument, ever played guitar or anything else? I never played anything else. The trombone. And when did you take up the trombone? 1925. 1925. 1925.
